parse.title: Tai Bwo Wannai Trio/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
====Burnt jogre bones====
{{Checklist|*Buy [[jogre bones]] off the [[Grand Exchange]] or kill them at the point labelled "Jogres"
*Light the bones on fire with a [[tinderbox]] (requires 30 [[Firemaking]]), use them on a [[furnace]] if you lack the required level.
*Wait for the fire to go out, then pick up the [[burnt jogre bones]]}}
